Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production animation spritesheet of YUUKI as a NINE-YEAR-OLD angel GIRL for a classic top-down Unity pixel RPG. Image1 is Yuuki's APPROVED CHILD IDENTITY, preserve exactly her face, pure WHITE waist-length hair and fringe, large RED eyes, small black bow with tiny white cross at her anatomical-left temple, short petite CHILD proportions, black bodice with white cross, white Peter-Pan collar, modest white skirt with black lace hem and black waist bow, white puff sleeves, white socks and black Mary Jane shoes. Empty hands; NO weapons or halo baked in. Two feathered wings ALWAYS ANATOMICAL LEFT BLACK and ANATOMICAL RIGHT WHITE. Hair remains white even where it overlaps the black wing, keep feathers distinct from hair. No adult body. Image2 is Alice's APPROVED animation sheet, STYLE AND LEG-MOTION reference ONLY: reproduce its crisp shaded small pixel-game rendering, modest child leg lengths, boot/shoe scale, soft four-phase walk/run cadence and subtle idle breathing. Draw Yuuki from image1, NEVER Alice, no blue trim, no black scalp hair, no blue bows. Do not copy Alice's wing colors! Camera slightly elevated like classic top-down RPG.
Sheet layout: landscape, EXACT FOUR uniform COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, ideally2048x1536,cells512x512. Eleven drawings: row1 FOUR WALK frames; row2 FOUR RUN frames; row3 THREE IDLE BREATHING frames in first3cells and fourthcell EMPTY transparent. Every entire head, hair end, wing tip and BOTH feet inside its own cell with wide transparent gutters and ample margin, no cropping at canvas edges. True RGBA alpha background, no checkerboard baked in, solid backdrop, floor shadow, labels/numbers/grid.
Motion: left-to-right cycle1 modest CONTACT A ->2 compact PASS A ->3 opposite CONTACT B ->4 compact PASS B ->1. Legs alternate which foot leads, consistent short child thighs/shins, identical shoe sizes; no stretched legs, extreme splits, leaps or sudden pose changes. Use exactly the reference's compact smoothly successive leg arrangement, one constant head/body scale and stable pelvis/crown registration per row, tiny natural bob. WALK moderate small step and gentle opposite arm swing. RUN slightly more energetic but still compact, softly bent elbows, short stride and natural knee bending. Hair sways only a little. Wings stay folded with tiny secondary sway, no flapping.
IDLE row: both shoes planted in SAME neutral position, arms resting at SAME relaxed angle, tiny chest/clothing rise for breathing (rest,small inhale,small exhale). No walking legs, head turns or jumps. Same body proportions across all states. No smudging, motion blur or distorted anatomy.
Direction: ALL11frames face SCREEN-RIGHT in the SAME three-quarter side camera as Alice inimage2. Yuuki's nearer, clearly visible wing is WHITE (anatomical RIGHT), with the far BLACK anatomical-left wing visible as a separate dark feather layer behind it. Both wings trail to screen-left. Nose and shoes point right. Keep hair bow on same anatomical temple; it can be partly hidden naturally. No front/back frames.
